verdict.rationale: Docs explicitly confirm an API-based, server-driven integration path (in addition to SDKs) for building a custom POS, with supporting infrastructure like reader registration, locations/zones, offline payment storage, and a simulated reader for testing without hardware; a hands-on developer account corroborates building a fully custom terminal integration via the API. missing for 10: no independent third-party benchmark of the raw REST/server-driven API surface itself (only docs + one anecdotal HN account).
